core_requests: P339 username lane (WP27): schedule modules tagged 'pack' in their own lane. Until then username_check.py bounds its own concurrency: a process-wide BoundedSemaphore(8) shared by both packs, and one request in flight per host with min_interval 1 s.

doctor v2 (P337/WP25): run the pack modules' HealthCheck(offline=False, selftest=...) in rotation. This is the FC15 calibration self-test: official claimed account FOUND plus random control ABSENT. It caches its verdict for a day in ctx.state and probes at most 25 sites per day.

DataStore (AR10): cap dataset download time by ctx.remaining() when ctx.data.fetch_json/fetch_text runs inside a module run. A slow first-run download of WhatsMyName or Sherlock (a few hundred KB) can push a run past timeout + RUN_GRACE, and the engine's AR05 rule then drops every result of the run.

ModuleState guard (context.py): a write is refused when any stored string contains the investigated value (3+ chars) as a substring. Engine health records keyed by site id or host (for example 'v3lum:kaggle' or 'en.gravatar.com') therefore cannot be saved during runs on handles such as 'kaggle' or 'com'. The pack skips the write and the run goes on. Suggest token-boundary matching, or a module-scoped state API that is not tied to the run entity, for bookkeeping that never holds the value.

P327 forbidden_probe flags URL shapes in third-party site lists that are not sign-up, reset or login endpoints: MediaWiki API usprop=registration, a profile page's '?login=' parameter, hosts with 'login' in a label. The pack drops them (54 drops in packs.json build_log.lint_dropped). If council wants them back, a reviewed allow-list would be needed.

Provider registry: a generated 'provider set' fragment type would let data-driven site lists (WhatsMyName ~430 and Maigret 2,446 candidates) register hosts with per-site terms, tier and rationale. Today each site needs its own hand-written provider file before its host can be declared (FC8/FC16 back-fill).

A5 names the overlay v3lum/data/username_overlay.json, but batch file ownership puts module data under v3lum/data/<module>/, so it ships as v3lum/data/username_check/overlay.json. Please update the reference in the spec / contract additions.

Feedback loop (FC15): expose per-site analyst 'marked wrong' votes to modules (through ctx, or by writing them back to the overlay), so the 3-strikes rule counts analyst votes as well as the module's own control-FOUND strikes.
notes:
P113 is delivered as one checker engine (v3lum/modules/username_social/username_check.py) and two modules. username_check is the default pack: passive, default_enabled, run_on seeds. username_check_extended is the opt-in pack: tags slow and people_sweep, default_enabled false.
The engine evaluates each site as FOUND, ABSENT or UNKNOWN from two-sided markers (status plus strings) measured by V3LUM; no WhatsMyName text is copied into bundled data. A FOUND hit is confirmed against a random 20-char control. 403, 429, challenge, login wall, redirect, timeout and errors inside a 200 body all read as 'could not verify' (blocked / rate_limited / error), never as absent. A host stops after 403/429/challenge. Concurrency is at most 8 global and 1 per host, with min_interval 1 s and per-site timeout 10 s. Request caps are 150 (default) and 600 (extended), with deadlines 120 s / 600 s.
Each run reports 'N found · N could not verify · N absent · N not checked: budget' plus a coverage appendix. Hits are POSSIBLE info findings marked 'same handle does not prove identity', with high_collision tags for common handles (data/username_check/collision.json). Pivots are profile URLs (has_account, expand false). Evidence keeps a sha256 of each body. Sensitive categories (nsfw, dating, religion, health, politics) are filtered out, as are platforms owned by other proposals and endpoints flagged by the P327 oracle lint.
Datasets: the WhatsMyName archived copy (CC BY-SA 4.0, runtime download, sha256-pinned, never bundled), the Sherlock manifest and false-positive exclusions (MIT, refreshed daily), and Maigret db_meta plus sites (MIT, large, sha256 checked against db_meta, never fetched during a scan). Notices are in v3lum/data/notices/username_check_*.json.
Fail-closed scope today: only Gravatar has registry terms 'open' with evidence, so the default pack holds 1 site (Gravatar). About.me, Dribbble and Kaggle (extended pack) have terms 'unknown' with ToS quotes recorded in their own provider fragments; the engine skips them (SKIPPED licence) and the self-test does not probe them. Linktree is excluded (Sherlock exclusion list plus ToS). Maigret back-fill waits for legal approval (maigret_backfill_approved false).
Calibrations were measured from the sandbox egress (team_egress false). personal_data_review is still missing for every site (FC14), so POL-07 runs the packs only when they are selected explicitly with a purpose. All of this is tracked with unblock conditions in docs/backlog/p1-G05-2.md, and packs.json is rebuilt with build_selection() (module docstring) once legal records terms.
The overlay path deviates from A5 (see core_requests). No core or shared file was modified. Tests: 53 offline tests for username_check and 10 for username_check_extended pass, 4 live tests pass with V3LUM_LIVE=1, and the registry contract test passes. lint_tree reports 0 issues and ruff check is clean.
